verdict.rationale: The documentation only shows Base44 acting as an MCP *server* (exposing its own account/app data or docs to external AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), not as a client that can ingest third-party MCP servers so its own agents can use their tools. Superagent/agent tool-connection features (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, etc.) are described as native integrations, not MCP plug-ins, so there is no evidence Base44 lets a user 'plug in' arbitrary MCP servers for its agents to consume.
